headline: M&G Urges UK Action to Stop London Stock Exchange Exits After Compass Departure
summary: The boss of investment group M&G urged the UK government to take a stand against companies leaving the London Stock Exchange after Compass announced plans to move its main listing to New York.
why: The London Stock Exchange has faced a wave of departures by major firms seeking higher valuations in overseas markets like New York, raising structural concerns for the UK financial sector.

impacts.name: M&G
impacts.why: Regulatory and structural changes in the UK market affect domestic asset managers and exchange liquidity.
